title: Vietnam Brand Agency for International Markets | Bunchasake
description: We help Vietnamese brands enter Europe and the US: positioning for the new market, identity, English brand voice and a website buyers abroad understand.
h1: A Vietnamese brand agency for international markets, seen from both sides
lead: A good product is not enough abroad. As a Vietnamese brand agency for international markets, we shape your story, name, look and English voice for a buyer in Milan or Berlin.

problems.title: What holds a Vietnamese brand back abroad

items.q: It sells well at home. Abroad, nobody replies.
items.p: A buyer in Europe has never heard of you. Without a clear story and a credible look, the email gets skipped.

items.q: Our English was translated word for word.
items.p: The grammar may be right while the tone is not. What sounds respectful in Vietnamese can read as vague in English.

items.q: Our name and packaging only make sense in Vietnam.
items.p: A name that is hard to say, or a design full of local references, asks the buyer to do extra work.

sections.h2: Why work with a Vietnamese brand agency for international markets
sections.html:
We are a Vietnamese studio working between Vietnam and Italy. We know how a founder in Vietnam tells the story, and we see how a customer in Europe hears it. That view from both sides is what cross-border marketing from Vietnam often lacks.

Before any design work, we look at the brand the way a buyer abroad would:

  • Can they say and remember the name?
  • Does the story answer: why buy from a company I have never heard of?
  • Does the identity hold up next to the brands already on that shelf?
  • Does the website answer their first questions in clear English?

For a Vietnam to Europe market entry, have these answers ready before the first trade fair. See our article on how Vietnamese brands can enter European markets.

sections.h2: English content for Vietnamese brands, written for the buyer
sections.html:
English content for Vietnamese brands usually starts as a translation. The words are correct, but the page still reads like a brochure for the home market.

Take a furniture maker in Bình Dương selling to Germany. High quality, reasonable price, prestige tells the buyer nothing. Which wood, who makes it, what they can count on: that is a voice a buyer remembers.

So we set the key messages during positioning, then write the brand voice in English and Vietnamese: how the brand introduces itself, which words it uses and avoids, how formal it is. Your team applies it on the website, company profile, packaging and in the social media automation system.

Already running a business abroad? See our page for Vietnamese business owners abroad.

faq.q: We are in Vietnam. How do we work with you?
faq.a: Online or in person. You email us, we have a 60-minute conversation, then you receive a proposal and quote.

faq.q: Do you write in English or in Vietnamese?
faq.a: Both. We listen to the founder in Vietnamese and write the brand voice for buyers in English.

faq.q: Are you an international marketing agency in Vietnam that runs ads abroad?
faq.a: No. We do not run ads, book influencers or arrange distribution. We build the brand those efforts rely on.

faq.q: We already have a logo and packaging. Must we start again?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The Refresh package audits the current brand, repositions it for the new market, and refreshes the identity and touchpoints.
It depends on the package: Start, Build or Refresh. The quote comes after the first conversation.
